title: Attack-Path Summary Foundation
goal: Turn existing inventory and findings into path-oriented operator guidance by building the first attack-graph service and choke-point summary without jumping straight to a heavy graph UI.
scope: Implement the first attack-path slice by expanding the placeholder attack-path service into a real run-scoped graph builder, exposing candidate path and choke-point summaries through API contracts, and surfacing those summaries in an existing review surface. Keep advanced graph rendering and identity-aware path expansion out of this slice.
generation_reason: Anti-drift hardening for the repo-backed post-intake backlog.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not promote or implement this task until the current task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed and logged.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep this slice to service-level path construction plus a summary UI. Defer D3/Cytoscape graph rendering, identity-edge expansion, and risk-scoring integration.
notes: Define a choke point as any node that appears in three or more candidate paths in this slice.
Use selected-run inventory, findings, and existing host relationship hints only.

success_criteria: The placeholder attack-path service produces nodes, edges, candidate paths, and choke-point summaries for a selected run.
An API contract exposes those summaries without inventing a second data model.
Operators can review candidate paths and choke points from an existing analysis surface without a blank placeholder.
Zero-data and low-data runs return a truthful empty or low-confidence path summary.
Service and UI tests cover multi-host paths, zero-data fallbacks, and choke-point thresholds.

acceptance_criteria: A run with usable inventory and findings returns at least one candidate path or a truthful statement that no path could be derived.
Choke points are calculated from a documented threshold instead of a vague heuristic.
The UI summary does not imply identity-aware or cross-environment chaining before those layers exist.

before_promotion: The active conversational-intake task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed, logged, and removed from active status.
python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py passes with this package still queued.
No graph-library dependency is introduced in this slice.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with the attack-path foundation behavior and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the path-summary capability and its current limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md and rerun python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py.
